summary: Reported speech modal structure (speaker under author, reporting verbs under speaker, content author-only, :quote on all content events); 时 phrases and year-event names; news noun + title head and ability identity-91; general predicate+人/者 split and prefix :mod; no nodes for clause-chaining 还/甚至/也; -00 rule, V到, 靠-type :reason; discourse frames without aspect/modal; :topic roles; chained conjuncts; reported dates. Removed narrow rules and redundant checklist lines to fit.

edits.old: - Reported speech or thought: `(author :full-affirmative s9p)` for the speaker; every predicate of the content (also an appended slogan and later clauses about that source's reports) gets both `(author :full-affirmative e)` and `(s9p :full-affirmative e)`; event nominals that are arguments inside the content get author only. The content's top node carries `:quote <saying verb>`.
edits.new: - Reported speech or thought: `(author :full-affirmative src)` for the speaker; every reporting or claiming verb with that speaker as subject (each verb of a series of reports too) gets `(src :full-affirmative verb)`, not an author link; every predicate of the content gets `(author :full-affirmative e)` only.

edits.old: The reported content's top event, and each of its conjuncts, always gets `:quote <reporting event>`
edits.new: Every event of the reported content (top event, conjuncts, nested reason, manner and complement events) gets `:quote <reporting event>`

edits.old: Both frames get `(author :full-affirmative h)` and no temporal parent.
edits.new: Discourse frames (these two, but-91, contrast-91) get no aspect and no modal or temporal link.

edits.old: a purpose or intended action is `activity`;
edits.new: a purpose or intended action is `activity` (one carried out in a past narrative takes the main event's aspect);

edits.anchor: Every location postposition likewise: 在 N 中/上/里 → `(z / 中 :op1 N)`.
edits.text: Not 时/的时候: after a clause or event noun it gets no node and the event itself is `:temporal`; year + 年 + event noun (+ 时) is one named `event` (2.2), no date-entity, no 时 node, no temporal link.

edits.old: A 「」/“” article or headline title used with a classifier or next to an article/news noun is a name too:
edits.new: A 「」/“” article or headline title after a bare classifier is a name too:

edits.text: With a common news/article noun, that noun is the head (`:quant`/`:unit`, `:part-of` the periodical) and is `:ARG1-of (i / identity-91 :ARG2 (p / publication :name …) :aspect state)`, author link.

edits.old: An `identity-91` reifying an apposition inside a noun phrase gets no `:aspect` and no links at all.
edits.new: An `identity-91` reifying an apposition on a named entity gets no `:aspect` and no links at all.

edits.anchor: country `:place` and former `:mod` on the title.
edits.text: Ability/right/chance noun + verb phrase: `noun :ARG1-of (i / identity-91 :ARG2 <event> :aspect state)`, author link, no temporal link; the event gets `(author :neutral-affirmative e)`.

edits.old: separately, a role noun built from a verb + 人/者 is `(r / 人 :ARG0-of (v / verb-0N ...))` (`performance` for a completed act, e.g. founding).
edits.new: separately, any predicate stem (verb or adjective) + 人/者 is split: `(r / 者 :ARG0-of (v / stem-0N … :aspect state))` when the person does or has it (`performance` for a completed act), `:ARG1-of (v … :aspect process)` when it is done to them. 全/各/该 + noun → `noun :mod 全`.

edits.anchor: Frequency adverbs (经常, 常常, 往往, 重复; *often, repeatedly*) are `:frequency`.
edits.text: Exception: 还, 甚至 and 也 that only mark a clause as additional or climactic relative to another clause of the same sentence (later conjunct, second half of but-91, reported clause) get no node.

edits.old:
a Chinese predicate that is not
in PropBank is `<word>-00`.
edits.new:
write `<word>-00` unless
`propbank_lookup` returned that exact roleset. A verb + result complement token (V到) is one concept.

edits.anchor: Discourse 就/便 outside a condition gets no node.
edits.text: - 靠/凭/通过 N (relying on N) + main verb: no node for the 靠-type verb; N (or its event) is `:reason` of the main verb.

edits.anchor: or an article of a publication → `:part-of` (not `:possessor`).
edits.text: An issue or matter of X (X 的 问题) and a domain noun on a policy-type noun → `:topic`.
Coordinated conjuncts form a chain: each later conjunct `:overlap`s (or follows) the previous conjunct, not the first.
Exception: a date inside reported content gets no temporal parent; the content event takes the reporting verb as parent (`:before` for a past event claimed later).

edits.old: - Compounds split (prefix + noun, verb + 人/者); 「」 titles are unanalysed names.
edits.new: - Every attributive adjective: check its roleset before writing `:mod`.

edits.old: - Same-sentence pronouns are re-entrancies, repeated nouns own nodes + `:coref`; control subjects re-enter nominal complements; a time over both halves of but-91 attaches to both.

A Chinese zero subject or object that is clearly
recoverable may be added as such a node (aligned to no word) and linked by coreference.

- When a component, edition or section noun modifies a named work through 的 ([X] 版 的 《N》), the component noun is the head
  and the work is its `:part-of`; modifiers of the component (colour, style) stay on it. A trailing relative clause on such an object attaches to the component noun.

When X and Y are components (layout, edition, format) of the subject, the subject is `:part-of` on X, not its own argument and not an inverse `:part`, even when it also fills a role elsewhere (that role is then a re-entrancy).

- **Fame in a defining sentence.** The fame state has no temporal parent; it is the parent of the habitual RC event `(fame :contained e)`, which keeps its own DCT link; the reason event `:overlap`s e.
- Relative clause headed by an aspectual verb ("N that has stopped V-ing"): N is `:ARGn-of` the inner verb, which is `:ARG1-of` the aspectual verb; N is not its argument.
With no head noun (其中 最 Adj + classifier): `(i / implicit-argument :unit <classifier> :ARG1-of (h / have-degree-91 :ARG1 (a / Adj) :ARG2 (m / 最) :ARG5 (q / 其中)))`.
